facts.fact: Economia & Mercado, from the MESCTI Anuario Estatistico, reports about 11% of Angola's 29,302 tertiary graduates in 2022/23 were in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (under 3,200).

note: No STEM graduate share or research network stated.
Only an Expansao calculation for 2014-2023 (engineering, technology, manufacturing and ICT 10% of graduates); not an official STEM share and no research and education network.

facts.fact: The MESCTI yearbook says 3,076 (9.8%) of the 31,503 graduates of academic year 2022-2023 were in STEM.

note: Gross tertiary enrolment is not STEM graduates share or a research and education network.
